mapper.select: SELECT bookmark_id, user_id, category_id, goal_id, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM user_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY bookmark_id DESC
